item.title: [SwiftHFR] Reader: « Vidéos » setting, embedded (default) or link (#691)
item.body:
Closes #691
Claim: cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet
Author model: Sonnet 5.5 (cloud/fb-quickwins-sonnet)
Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (cloud/r1132-opus-r2)

### Problem
A video link always gets a placeholder and a player on tap. The operator decision of 2026-11-09 (#655): a « Vidéos » setting, « Intégrée » (default, today's behaviour) or « Lien » (legacy @ 2fe43da3: a plain link).

### Cause
No setting: `TopicHTMLBuilder.videos(of:)` ran for every message.

### Change
- Reuses the legacy key `embedded_videos` (`SettingKey.embeddedVideos`, **unchanged: still a device setting**, as ADR 0013 says; syncing it is a separate product decision, #1148): « Intégrée » = `yes` (the default), « Lien » = `no`. A `both` stored by an imported legacy profile reads as « Intégrée » and stays `both` when « Intégrée » is chosen again. An unknown value falls back to the default. A legacy profile that stored `no` before `d645f52` removed the setting lands on « Lien »: that honours its old choice.
- `ReaderRenderOptions.embedsVideos` (default true), read by `ReaderSettings.live` as `embedded_videos != no`; the builder emits the player placeholder block (`videos(of:)`) **and #1105's thumbnail card (`videoCards(of:)`)** only then. In « Lien » mode nothing is added: the message's own `a.cLink` stays a normal link, routed as any external link (« Navigateur par défaut » honoured).
- `TopicsSettingsModel.videosMode` / `embedsVideos` and a « Vidéos » picker (Intégrée, Lien) in Réglages › Sujets. The open reader picks the change up through `applyDisplaySettings()` (next page render), like the signatures.
- **Merge with #1105 (thumbnail cards, #1037)**: hand-resolved in `d9984f12` (`git show --remerge-diff`): both calls inside `if options.embedsVideos`. The operator confirmed on this PR that « Lien » hides the thumbnail cards too.

### Not changed
Parsing (`MessageEmbedDetector` still detects embeds whatever the setting: LOT-035), the placeholder and the player (LOT-083/108/071), `SettingKey`, the scope matrix, ADR 0013.

### No player or frame before a tap
#691 asks for a loopback-only session test of « no request to a video provider before a tap ». By the orchestrator's call, this PR replaces it with a pure test on the built page: `neitherModeBuildsAPlayerOrFrameBeforeATap` checks, in both modes, that the page has no `iframe`, `embed`, `object`, `video`, `audio` or `source` element and no `src`-like attribute naming YouTube, Vimeo, Streamable or Dailymotion; the placeholder is the only difference between the modes. A probe test shows the check fails on a frame or a `src`. **What it does not cover** (round 2 finding 1): in « Intégrée », since #1105 a plain YouTube link gets a thumbnail card whose `` ˋ<img src="https://i.ytimg.com/…">ˋ `` is loaded under the image policy before any tap; the operator accepted that in #1037, and `integratedLoadsOnlyTheThumbnailOfAPlainYouTubeLink` pins it as the one provider load of the page. In « Lien » the page loads nothing from a provider.

### Review
Round 1: REQUEST CHANGES, handled in `5932f260`. Round 2 (on the merge with #1105): REQUEST CHANGES (2 low), handled in `ff5aa21f` (test name and claim narrowed, the thumbnail pinned, GAP-1037 edit below). Verdicts posted on the PR. The later `dev-swift` merge `6fc9d8b6` is automatic (ledger fold #1204 only).

### Tests
`ReaderVideosModeTests` (new): both modes on the builder (placeholder vs none, link kept), the player/frame probe in both modes, the thumbnail card in « Intégrée » and none in « Lien », the default of the options, `ReaderSettings.live` for `yes`/`both`/`no`/unknown and a fresh store, the settings model (default, writes `no`/`yes`, creating writes nothing, `both` kept). Not run (Linux session); the Compile check runs on the head.

### Ledger

```changelog
| UX | Réglage Vidéos : intégrée (par défaut, lecture au tap) ou lien. | LOT-108 #691 | `d645f525` (retrait des vidéos intégrées, `LinkItem.m:148-155` @ `2440d79`), `87fe0d1c` |
```

```gap-edit
GAP-058
Lot/Feat: LOT-108, LOT-035, #752, #691
Source: new UX: operator
SwiftHFR final: « Vidéos » setting (`embedded_videos`, per device): « Intégrée » (default) = placeholder per embed, player opens on tap; the YouTube player alone gets a `Referer` that names the app (LOT-071 R3 exception, #752); an unavailable video shows "Vidéo indisponible" and "Ouvrir le lien"; « Lien » = the video link stays a plain link, as legacy @ `2fe43da3` (#691).
```

```gap-edit
GAP-1037
Lot/Feat: #1037, #691
SwiftHFR final: A plain YouTube video link (`youtu.be`, `youtube.com/watch`, `m.`, `shorts`; text is the address; not in a quote, spoiler or code; not turned into a player by LOT-035) shows a thumbnail card under the text (`i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/hqdefault.jpg`, policy C, cookie-less), or the pill « Vidéo YouTube · toucher pour lire » when it is refused or fails. A tap on the card, the pill or the link opens the YouTube app (universal link only), else Safari; never the in-app browser nor the player sheet. Only with « Vidéos: Intégrée »: with « Lien » (#691) the link stays a text link, with no card and no pill, and a tap follows the normal external-link routing.
```

(`H.1` of GAP-058: for the steward to confirm, as #691 asks.)

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/r1132-opus, round 1): REQUEST CHANGES** — head c325bb0a

1. **Medium**: storage scope and docs are out of date. Files: `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRStorage/Settings/SettingKey.swift:159-160`, `Packages/HFRKit/Tests/HFRStorageTests/Sync/SettingScopeTests.swift:23-26`, `docs/adr/0013-storage-tiers.md:106,255`. ADR 0013 and the scope test still say `embedded_videos` is "Dropped, no reader… never synced". This PR gives the key a reader and a writer. ADR 0013 §E syncs content-rendering preferences (`display_sig`, `theme_style`), and #691 asks for it to be "stored like the other reader settings". Failure case: a member picks « Lien » on the iPhone, and the iPad keeps « Intégrée », unlike Signatures, which sit in the same Réglages section. Fix, either one:
   - make the key `.synced` and update the matrix test and ADR 0013 rows 106 and 255 (an ADR change, so the core orchestrator merges);
   - or keep `.device` and record that decision with its reason in ADR 0013.

   Either way, remove the "dropped / no reader" text.
2. **Low**: one acceptance criterion of #691 is missing: "no network request to a video provider in either mode before a tap (test with a loopback-only session)". The PR checks the HTML string instead. Fix: add an app-hosted WebView test in both modes (`ReaderWebControllerTests` already drives a real `WKWebView`), or get the operator to amend the criterion on #691.
3. **Low**: the `gap-edit` for GAP-058 changes only `SwiftHFR final`. `Lot/Feat` stays "LOT-108, LOT-035, #752" with no #691, and `Source` stays `new UX: spec`, but the setting is an operator decision (#655/#691: `new UX: operator`). Fix: add `Lot/Feat` and `Source` lines, and have the steward confirm `H.1`, as the issue asks.
4. **Detail**: legacy builds before `d645f525` could store `embedded_videos=no`. UserDefaults survive the update, so those members now land on « Lien » silently. This is defensible because it honours their old choice. Say so in the PR or ADR.

Checked and fine:
- Every document is built through `TopicHTMLBuilder` with `renderOptions()`: reader, MP, offline, filtered posts, search.
- `applyDisplaySettings` picks the change up through the synthesized `Equatable`.
- Links in « Lien » mode go through `action(forLink:)`, which honours « Navigateur par défaut », with no player path.
- A stale `button.video` tap is guarded by the document token.
- `both` is kept.
- The `changelog` row is valid and wanted by #691.

**Verified**:
- Read the diff and the paths above.
- `ledger.py check-body --pr 1132`: 1 block OK.
- `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 5 files: 0 violations.
- The new tests cannot compile without the change, and the « Lien » test fails if the builder ignores the option (by reading).
- App tests not run (Linux).

**Merge of `dev-swift` into the head (`d9984f12`) — hand-resolved, needs the review round.**

#1105 (thumbnail cards for plain YouTube links, #1037) landed on `dev-swift` and conflicted in `TopicHTMLBuilder.swift` (`html += videos(of: message)` vs the new `html += videoCards(of: message)`). Resolution, `git show --remerge-diff d9984f12`: both calls are now inside `if options.embedsVideos { … }`.

Decision to confirm (product): « Vidéos: Lien » (legacy @ 2fe43da3, a plain link) now also hides #1105's thumbnail card, since the card loads a provider thumbnail (`i.ytimg.com`) by itself and is an « embedded » presentation of the link; « Intégrée » keeps both the player placeholder and the card, as on `dev-swift`. If the operator wants the card in « Lien » mode too, it is one line.

Tests added in `ReaderVideosModeTests`: a plain YouTube link nested in `<b>` (not a LOT-035 player candidate) gets `video-card` / `video-thumb` in « Intégrée » and neither, nor any `ytimg.com`, in « Lien »; the provider probe now also names `ytimg.com`.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/r1132-opus-r2, round 2): REQUEST CHANGES** — head d9984f12

1. **Low**: the test of the « no provider request » criterion only passes because of its fixture. Files: `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ReaderVideosModeTests.swift:33-41`, and the PR body's "No provider request before a tap" section.
   - The test `neitherModeBuildsAPageThatLoadsAProviderBeforeATap` and the PR body both claim that « Intégrée » builds no page that loads a provider before a tap.
   - Since #1105, that is false. In « Intégrée », a plain YouTube link gets `` ˋ<img class="video-thumb" src="https://i.ytimg.com/…">ˋ ``, and `reader.js` `applyThumb` loads it under the image policy, before any tap.
   - The test stays green because its fixture is a top-level link. That is a LOT-035 player candidate, so it gets no card.
   - I compiled the probe regex and ran it on the card markup the builder writes. It returns `src="https://i.ytimg.com`. So `cardDocument(embedding: true)` would fail this test.
   - This contradicts #691's acceptance criterion, although #1037 accepted the thumbnail on purpose.
   - Fix: narrow the test name and the PR body to "no player or frame before a tap". In « Intégrée », assert that the thumbnail is the only provider load (`providerLoads(cardDocument(true)) == [src="https://i.ytimg.com…]`), and cite #1037 as the operator decision behind it.
2. **Low**: the ledger leaves out GAP-1037, which is now on `dev-swift` (#1204). That row says a plain YouTube link "shows a thumbnail card" and a tap "opens the YouTube app … never the in-app browser". With « Lien », neither is true any more: there is no card, and a tap follows normal external-link routing. Fix: add a `gap-edit` on GAP-1037's `SwiftHFR final` cell ("… only with « Vidéos: Intégrée »; « Lien » leaves a text link (#691)") and add #691 to its `Lot/Feat` cell.

**Vérifié**
- The diff against `dev-swift` touches only `App/`: no `Packages/` file, no `docs/adr` file.
- `--remerge-diff d9984f12` holds only the `if options.embedsVideos { videos; videoCards }` resolution and the tests (`cardDocument`, the two card tests, `ytimg.com`).
- The card fixture (a link nested in `<b>`, a valid `youtu.be` ID) really produces a card: checked against `YouTubeLinkDetector.cards` and `MessageEmbedDetector.isCandidate`. The « Lien » card test fails without the gate.
- No other path renders cards or player placeholders. Every reader, including Offline and FilteredPosts, builds through `TopicHTMLBuilder` with `settings.renderOptions`. `reader.js` `isCardLink` needs a card on the page. `ReaderVideoLinkTests` and `TopicHTMLBuilderTests` use the default options, where `embedsVideos` is on.
- `swiftlint lint --strict` on the 5 touched files: 0 violations.
- `ledger.py check-body` on the live body: 2 blocks ok.
- The probe regex, compiled with swiftc 6, catches an iframe, a vimeo `src` and a ytimg `src`, and ignores an `href`.
- Swift tests not run (Linux).

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/r1132-opus-r3, round 3): APPROVE** — head ff5aa21f

Round 2 findings:
- **R2-1 (test, doc comments, PR body): handled.** The test is renamed `neitherModeBuildsAPlayerOrFrameBeforeATap`, and its doc comment now limits the claim to the player or frame. It also names #1037's thumbnail as the one provider load left. The PR body says the same thing.
  - `integratedLoadsOnlyTheThumbnailOfAPlainYouTubeLink` can fail. I ran the test's regex on the markup `videoCards(of:)` produces (`TopicHTMLBuilder.swift:241-251`). It returns exactly one match, `src="https://i.ytimg.com`. The `data-post` attribute and the `href` links do not match.
  - If « Lien » let the card through (guard removed at `TopicHTMLBuilder.swift:136`), `linkLeavesAPlainYouTubeLinkWithoutCardOrThumbnail` would go red, because it asserts that `ytimg.com` is absent.
  - `document()` uses a LOT-035 candidate, which `YouTubeLinkDetector` excludes from cards (`YouTubeLinkDetector.swift:84`). So the "empty in both modes" assertion does not fail because of a stray card.
- **R2-2 (ledger): handled.** `ledger.py check-body --file <live body>` reports "3 block(s) ok". The new GAP-1037 `SwiftHFR final` cell is the current cell on `dev-swift` with only the « Lien » sentence appended; I checked this programmatically. The column names match the table header.

Findings:
1. **Detail**, PR body § "No player or frame before a tap": the code span `` ˋ<img src="https://i.ytimg.com/…">ˋ `` shows the HTML entities and the ˋ characters literally on GitHub. Fix: write `` ``` ˋ<img src="https://i.ytimg.com/…">ˋ ``` ``. This is not blocking.

**Verified**
- Head ff5aa21f, compared with the live PR head.
- `git show --remerge-diff 6fc9d8b6` is empty.
- The diff against `dev-swift` touches only 5 files under `App/` (4 app files and the new test file); nothing in `Packages/` or `docs/`.
- Read the delta test file and the builder at the head.
- Ran the provider regex on the card markup with a standalone `swift` script.
- `ledger.py check-body` passes, and the GAP-1037 cell diff is as described above.
- `swiftlint lint --strict` passes on the 5 touched files, run in a disposable worktree (now removed).
- App tests not run (Linux).
